title.zh: 如何选择适合自己的职业
title.en: How to choose a class that fits you

description.zh: 从玩法偏好出发的选职业思路：职责、距离、操作量与单人体验。
description.en: A preference-first approach to picking a class: role, range, complexity and solo experience.

heading.zh: 先想清楚你喜欢什么玩法
heading.en: Start with how you like to play

body.zh: 与其问“哪个职业最强”，不如先回答：你喜欢近战还是远程？愿意承担坦克或治疗职责吗？更常单人游戏还是打地下城？这些偏好对长期体验的影响远大于短期的强度波动。
body.en: Instead of asking which class is strongest, ask yourself: melee or ranged? Willing to tank or heal? Mostly solo or in dungeons? These preferences shape your long-term experience far more than short-term balance swings.

heading.zh: 用职业选择器做偏好匹配
heading.en: Use the class selector for preference matching

body.zh: 本站的职业选择器根据你的答案进行偏好匹配并说明推荐理由。它是偏好匹配工具，不是强度排名——任何“最强职业”的说法都需要当前版本的实测数据支撑。
body.en: Our class selector matches your answers to classes and explains the reasoning. It is a preference-matching tool, not a power ranking - any claim about the strongest class requires tested data from the current version.

body.zh: 不要只看等级列表顶部的职业；留意每个推荐结果的“可能的缺点”。如果你完全不确定，选择职责灵活的职业可以在不换号的情况下尝试更多玩法。
body.en: Don't just pick whatever tops a tier list - read the possible drawbacks of each recommendation. If you are unsure, a flexible class lets you try more playstyles without rerolling.

provenance.notes: General advice; contains no game-version-specific claims.
